Serve explicitly configured libsy algorithms

Usage: switchyard-server [OPTIONS] --config <PATH>

Options:
      --config <PATH>        TOML file defining LLM clients, targets, and algorithm routes
      --host <HOST>          Host address to bind [default: 0.0.0.0]
  -p, --port <PORT>          Port to bind [default: 4000]
      --backlog <BACKLOG>    TCP listen backlog passed to the socket before Axum accepts traffic [default: 65535]
      --dry-run              Validate the algorithm and client configuration without binding a socket
      --tls-cert <TLS_CERT>  TLS certificate path in PEM format
      --tls-key <TLS_KEY>    TLS private-key path in PEM format
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
